_fontAliasNote: Figma masters label CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships the SC variant + Plus Jakarta Sans Latin glyphs. Same Huawei family.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock + data-driven amounts/dates/pairs. Mock fixtures (formatted balances, FX pair labels, transaction amounts) are not the diff target — the diff scores DESIGN not DATA.
